reason: Twelve verified defects in the chat workbench UI. SessionsPage: resumeInterruptedResponse and the waiting-callback follow streamed with no AbortSignal, never owned abortRef, and applied events without a selection guard, so switching conversations mid-resume let the earlier conversation's replayed ledger (Core replays from sequence 0 on follow) flip the URL back and append its final message to the other transcript; resetConversation batched setDraft('') with the key change so New chat erased the previous conversation's unsent draft; replacedMessages was never cleared at conversation boundaries so an edited chat's 'replaced messages' disclosure showed in a fresh chat; openAttachedChat set sessionId/messages without advancing the selection generation so an in-flight selectSession load could overwrite it; the rename form had no busy state so a double Enter sent two renames with the same expectedRevision and surfaced a false 409. MissionControls: X/Cancel closed the dialog while startMission was in flight so a failure was never shown; an effect reset typed execution limits whenever an MCP server was ticked or background verification flipped; runtime readiness was not refetched when the project changed while open; the datetime-local min was built from UTC. CodeEditorPanel: a suggestion for a selected range was spliced into the first identical occurrence. WorkbenchBrowser: navigation failures on a live tab were stored only on the tab and rendered only on the start surface; traffic/frames grew without bound. DiagnosticsPanel: overlapping refreshes let the older response win; a failed protected-detail access changed only a button label. Fixes: a beginGuardedStream helper (chatStreamLifecycle.ts) owns the transport and gates callbacks/finally on the selection generation and is used by both resume paths; resetConversation clears replacedMessages and only discards the draft when the conversation was deleted; openAttachedChat refreshes the list then routes through selectSession; a renamingBusy flag; dialogBusy disables X/Cancel; the concurrency default applies only until touched and the tool-call reset moved to open; engagement.id added to the readiness deps; localDateTimeInputValue formats min from local components; selection offsets from onSelectionChange with a range check; a live-tab error notice and boundSessionHistory caps per session; a refresh sequence guard and a visible DiagnosticErrorNotice on the failure card. Tests: MissionControls.test.tsx (4 new: busy dialog, kept limits, project re-check, local min), CodeEditorPanel.test.tsx (2 new: range splice, changed-range refusal), WorkbenchBrowser.test.tsx (2 new: bounded history, live-tab alert), DiagnosticsPanel.test.tsx (2 new: newest refresh wins, visible sensitive-detail failure), chatStreamLifecycle.test.ts (3 new for beginGuardedStream). All 13 new tests fail on main. SessionsPage defects 2-5 have no unit seam without rendering the 4K-line page and are covered by the typecheck/build and review only.
exclusions: No Python tests: no src/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: the impact rules match areas assistant, chat-edit-in-place, browser-complete, desktop-interface and mobile-layout through SessionsPage.tsx, WorkbenchBrowser.tsx and the component files, but those journeys do not switch conversations during a resumed provider stream, race an execution-attached chat against a selection load, double-submit a rename, tick MCP servers after typing a limit, run in a non-UTC zone, or apply an AI suggestion to a repeated selection; the vitest files drive each behaviour directly with controlled promises. No real-browser pass was run. No full suites.
